title: Build guest order claim flow and fix dead CTAs
goal: Let guests claim/view a purchased order by claim token and fix dead sign-in CTAs, per SIM-20260922-MKT-002 and SIM-20260922-USER-001.

in: Fix guest claim and checkout CTA links that currently point to dead /auth/sign-in and /auth/sign-up routes
Implement guest order claim by token with entitlement resolution
Add guest claim tests (success, bad token, expired, social login variants)
out: Guest access to order data beyond the claim token

acceptance_criteria.criterion: SIM-20260922-MKT-002 and SIM-20260922-USER-001 rerun and pass with receiving-side evidence

evidence: Jest lib/marketplace/__tests__/checkout-p6.test.ts: 1 suite / 12 tests passed (4 suites / 23 tests combined run).
Vitest lib/marketplace/__tests__ baseline: 15 files / 147 tests passed (no regression).
ESLint on all six changed files: exit 0.
No hosted run; staged rerun of SIM-20260922-MKT-002 / SIM-20260922-USER-001 pending isolated staging evidence.

Acceptance criterion status: NOT MET. It is a hosted simulation rerun with receiving-side evidence and no staging was available to this lane. Local implementation and link-contract coverage are complete.
npx vitest run __tests__/marketplace/guest-order-claim.test.ts: 1 file, 15 tests passed (was 11 before this wave added the unsettled-payment and lost-race cases).

npx vitest run lib/marketplace/__tests__ __tests__/marketplace: 19 files, 186 tests passed. npx eslint on 12 focused marketplace files: exit 0. git diff --check on the marketplace working set: exit 0.
Transferred from the v1 task; this gate does not keep a locally complete domain implementation active.

progress.summary: Wave 33: the guest claim flow and dead-CTA fix are complete locally and the claim route was hardened twice. It now refuses to claim an order whose payment has not settled, and refuses a claim that loses the buyer_user_id race rather than reporting success and backfilling entitlements under the losing user. Focus went from 11 to 15 tests in the claim suite. The acceptance criterion itself is a hosted simulation rerun and remains unmet.
completed: Wired guest order claim: new client trigger (app/marketplace/order/components/guest-order-claim.tsx) with post-login auto-claim (?claim=1), manual claim for signed-in visitors, and canonical login CTAs via lib/marketplace/order-claim.ts URL helpers.

Fixed dead CTAs in app/marketplace/order/[token]/page.tsx: /auth/sign-up and /auth/sign-in replaced with /login?tab=signup|signin&redirectTo=/marketplace/order/<token>?claim=1 (canonical route; no new auth routes created).

Extended claim route to resolve guest entitlements to the claimant: updates marketplace_entitlements.buyer_user_id from null to the user for the order's digital items only; idempotent same-user retry re-resolves entitlements; entitlement backfill failure returns 500 so retry completes it.

Added Vitest suites: __tests__/marketplace/guest-order-claim.test.ts (success incl. entitlement scoping, bad token, signed-out 401, unconfirmed email 403, expired 410, not-found 404, other-user 409, email mismatch 403, idempotent retry, no-digital-items, backfill failure 500) and __tests__/marketplace/order-claim-cta.test.ts (no /auth/sign-* links remain, claim prompt renders, canonical hrefs, redirect normalization).

Claim route now requires payment_status paid or refunded before linking an order to an account or resolving its digital entitlements; pending and failed orders return 409. This closed a fail-open path where an abandoned unpaid guest order could be claimed and have its delivery unlocked.

Claim route now verifies the guarded buyer_user_id write with select/maybeSingle and returns 409 when a concurrent request won the race, so the losing caller is never told it claimed the order and never runs entitlement backfill under its own user id.
Added 4 focused cases: unpaid refusal, failed-payment refusal, refunded-order still claimable, and lost-race refusal asserting no entitlement update was issued.
next_steps: Run SIM-20260922-MKT-002 and SIM-20260922-USER-001 on isolated staging: guest checkout, claim CTAs, sign-up with the matching email, order visible in /marketplace/purchases, digital download working after token expiry, and a different-email sign-in denied.
Confirm against the live marketplace_entitlements schema that the buyer_user_id backfill behaves as coded; it has never been exercised against a real table.
blockers: The acceptance criterion requires receiving-side actor evidence on isolated staging with protected Stripe test mode and campaign actors. None were provisioned, so the criterion is not met and no hosted rerun is claimed.
The entitlement backfill is code-level only and has never run against the live marketplace_entitlements schema; no hosted mutation, migration or SQL was executed (CP-051 respected).

checkpoints.summary: Guest order claim flow wired and dead auth CTAs fixed; local claim and link-contract tests plus focused Jest checkout suites pass. Acceptance rerun with receiving-side staging evidence remains open.
completed: Claim trigger: new client component renders canonical /login CTAs with ?claim=1 redirect, auto-claims after login, and offers manual claim for signed-in visitors; success reloads the clean order URL so the server page re-renders claimed.
Dead CTAs removed from app/marketplace/order/[token]/page.tsx (lines 282/287) and pointed at /login?tab=signup|signin&redirectTo=<claim redirect>.
Claim route resolves guest digital entitlements to the claimant scoped to the order's digital items; idempotent same-user retries re-resolve.

Vitest: __tests__/marketplace/ 2 files / 16 tests passed (claim variants incl. success/bad token/expired/login-variant + CTA link contract). Jest: lib/marketplace/__tests__/checkout-p6.test.ts and app/api/marketplace/checkout/__tests__ 4 suites / 23 tests passed. Vitest lib/marketplace baseline 15 files / 147 tests passed. ESLint on all changed files exit 0.
Confirmed marketplace_entitlements delivery path serves claimed buyers: order.buyer_user_id set by claim, entitlement buyer_user_id backfilled, /api/marketplace/delivery requires matched buyer id.
checkpoints.next: Staging rerun of SIM-20260922-MKT-002 and SIM-20260922-USER-001 with campaign actors: guest checkout -> save-your-order sign-up -> order visible in purchases -> download works; wrong-email denied.
blockers: Isolated staging + protected Stripe test mode + campaign actors (RELEASE-007/QA-003/QA-004/QA-005) not provisioned; no live rerun this round.
No hosted mutation run; live schema behavior of marketplace_entitlements backfill unverified.
